rows.coder_note: The stated N (54,219) is the sample size of no candidate row, the platform alone does not identify a release, and reference 13 and the Synapse link are common to several candidate rows.

rows.quote: We integrated data from approximately 90,000 individuals across the deCODE (Diabetes Epidemiology: Collaborative Analysis of Diagnostic Criteria in Europe) [12] and UKB-PPP (UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project) [13] cohorts, analyzing 7,847 proteins.
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, Sveinbjornsson G, Magnusson MI, Styrmisdottir EL, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet. 2021;53(12):1712–21
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the deCODE data to reference 12, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is the source identifier of one candidate row only; the N in p002 (35,553) is the exact N of neither candidate row and names no other release.
